notes: AES-1: E. coli ATCC 4157 in Medium E + glucose, gentamicin (25-75 ug/ml among candidates) added 19 h after start, fixed 30 h later; Space (microgravity) vs Earth ground controls. All candidates are gentamicin-treated, so no untreated control (is_control left out). Space samples: treatment abx_translation;other_physical (microgravity). Growth phase left out (49 h static culture, sampled 30 h after drug addition, no phase word); culture mode/oxygen not described (FPA hardware). strain_group of ATCC 4157 not given. rRNA removed with Ribo-Zero Gold (Yeast) kit as written. WT re-read: ATCC 4157 unmodified -> wild_type.
